findings.description: Controller/DTO/DAO examples must be labelled illustrations; R excludes protocol/redirect/metrics endpoints, @Valid covers declared constraints; do not invent JPA usage.
findings.resolution: 普通业务R与协议例外分开，DTO/Controller节选标明范围，@Valid与业务校验分开；业务MyBatis和引擎持久化不冒称JPA接入。

findings.description: Constructor injection rationale incorrectly claims missing Spring beans are compile errors and version-specific official deprecation.
findings.resolution: 保留禁止字段注入，说明显式构造器/Bean/ObjectProvider例外；删去Spring历史版本断言及Bean缺失编译期保证，区分final与线程安全。

findings.description: Exception table confuses HTTP status and R.code, omits actual mappings/advice/filter boundaries.
findings.resolution: 八条实际MVC异常行保留HTTP/R.code差异和Filter/Gateway/协议边界；Auth/currentPOM/imports共存事实优先于旧Javadoc，不承诺所有JSON错误400。

findings.description: Logging and serialization rules must distinguish new-code conventions from every existing class; require UID only for Serializable classes.
findings.resolution: 日志级别与敏感数据约束保留；Serializable只要求实际实现类声明UID，DTO/record不机械强制序列化；规则脱敏不冒称完整保护。

findings.description: Collection/concurrency rules must preserve correctness and approved locking; capacity, null handling and thread safety are not universal guarantees.
findings.resolution: 集合容量与空检查按实际前提，显式线程池生命周期；并发集合不代替跨对象/数据库锁和模块并发协议。

findings.description: Naming/format/comment conventions need actual examples, Chinese code comments and explicit new-code scope, not unverified formatter enforcement.
findings.resolution: 命名/120宽度/短参数表为新增代码可读性规则，保留OperType等现有命名；中文代码注释和publicJavadoc规则保留，不冒称POM无声明格式器已验证。

findings.description: Functional permissions need trusted identity/assertion chain, public/ownership/internal exceptions and frontend/seed synchronization.
findings.resolution: JWT→可信断言→服务Authentication→方法权限明确；注册/协议/内部Token/ownership例外与seed/manifest/v-permission同步要求保留。

findings.description: DataPermission diagram/table wrongly restricts to sys_user and equates ALL to universal cross-tenant access.
findings.resolution: Auth三表映射与无通用TenantLine、领域固定拦截器次序分别说明；ALL/TENANT与上下文缺失不附条件不等于普遍跨租户授权。

findings.description: Role resolution, domain aggregate policies and new-table ownership mapping must match permission-aware actual source.
findings.resolution: 普通/permission-aware角色解析区分；领域owner/current-user/共享/子聚合映射由服务拥有，禁止给无列子表追加owner；在线ALL保留为特定例外。

findings.description: ThreadLocal set timing is wrong; cover filter/aspect cleanup and async boundaries.
findings.resolution: Auth在try内设置/finally清理；common-serviceFilter与方法Aspect生命周期分开；异步不自动传播，MQ需显式tenantId。

findings.description: XSS activation, Jackson 2/3 modules, query access methods, skip rules and fallback require actual source, not blanket sanitization.
findings.resolution: Servlet/Provider/classpath/Jackson2/3的真实激活条件、getParameter/Values与未覆盖Map、跳过条件、规则类型及非法regex行为如实同步。

findings.description: XSS Auth Redis invalidation and common-service cache/fallback boundaries must be distinct; headers are not input sanitization.
findings.resolution: Auth双Redis键TTL30分和主动失效、事务内删键竞态边界，common-service缓存/Auth/启用基线和权威关闭语义区分；响应头不冒称输入净化。

findings.description: MQ local transaction, tenant input, relay/admin query and schema ownership must retain current constraints and runtime limits.
findings.resolution: 正tenantId、实际本地事务、唯一DDL所有者、双注解、跨租户relay及tenant管理查询保留；送达/运行与依赖存在分开，教程归MQ/Wiki。

findings.description: OperLog example contradicts Auth prohibition; architecture and actual producer/consumer/archive scheduling need audit.
findings.resolution: OperLog改用真实Base字典update节选，Auth禁止规则保留；Outbox/直发/返回boolean限制与Base去重/重试、XXL归档handler/cron/180/1000按源修正。

findings.description: OperLog snapshots/truncation/SpEL/masking/failed operations and retention are scoped behavior, not comprehensive audit/compliance guarantees.
findings.resolution: 注解默认值与快照开关、tenant快照、顶层diff、规则脱敏、4000+标记及JSON风险、前置采集/responseStatus、归档同Bean事务限制均披露，不冒称全面审计或合规。

findings.description: Starter list, imports and override conditions are incomplete or overgeneralized; reactive module has no own custom imports.
findings.resolution: 10common/8customimports与reactive模块例外列明；MyBatis类型/Redis名称/RedisUtils返回型/OperLog无MissingBean条件分别解释，完整模块主源仍为架构。

findings.description: Configuration table has stale service set, weak password/token defaults and executor ports; distinguish formal Docker and YAML.
findings.resolution: 八服务宿主/容器、mysql私有omni_app、Nacos/JWKS映射与profile区分；Base9901与属性类9999、空通用Token与正式Compose私密Token不混同。

findings.description: Transactions readOnly/REQUIRES_NEW/Feign claims overstate guarantees; distinguish local transaction, proxy and remote effects.
findings.resolution: readOnly为提示而非授权，默认REQUIRED、本地/远程副作用、REQUIRES_NEW代理提交条件与自调用边界明确；Feign需独立协议适配。

findings.description: Troubleshooting and testing must retain local Docker, actual test scopes/conditional skips and exact source reuse without expensive repeats.
findings.resolution: 故障排查/源码调试职责和Docker句柄/副作用要求保留；JUnit/MockMvc/真实集成分开，条件skip不算pass，307精确树桥复用260/144不重跑未改构建。

checks.language_and_terminology: 18개 절 전체를 중국어와 현재 소스 범위에 대조했습니다. 일반API/프로토콜,HTTP/업무코드,범위/테넌트,Bean조건,로컬/원격/proxy 트랜잭션을 구분합니다. 신원·영속화·스냅샷·캐시 폴백·마스킹 용어가 같은 경계를 전달하며 실제 중국어 소스 진단과 기술 식별자는 유지했습니다. AI 검토를 사람 검토나 실업무 검증으로 부르지 않습니다.

findings.description: Controller/DTO/DAO examples must be labelled illustrations; R excludes protocol/redirect/metrics endpoints, @Valid covers declared constraints; do not invent JPA usage.
findings.resolution: 普通业务R与协议例外分开，DTO/Controller节选标明范围，@Valid与业务校验分开；业务MyBatis和引擎持久化不冒称JPA接入。

findings.description: Constructor injection rationale incorrectly claims missing Spring beans are compile errors and version-specific official deprecation.
findings.resolution: 保留禁止字段注入，说明显式构造器/Bean/ObjectProvider例外；删去Spring历史版本断言及Bean缺失编译期保证，区分final与线程安全。

findings.description: Exception table confuses HTTP status and R.code, omits actual mappings/advice/filter boundaries.
findings.resolution: 八条实际MVC异常行保留HTTP/R.code差异和Filter/Gateway/协议边界；Auth/currentPOM/imports共存事实优先于旧Javadoc，不承诺所有JSON错误400。

findings.description: Logging and serialization rules must distinguish new-code conventions from every existing class; require UID only for Serializable classes.
findings.resolution: 日志级别与敏感数据约束保留；Serializable只要求实际实现类声明UID，DTO/record不机械强制序列化；规则脱敏不冒称完整保护。

findings.description: Collection/concurrency rules must preserve correctness and approved locking; capacity, null handling and thread safety are not universal guarantees.
findings.resolution: 集合容量与空检查按实际前提，显式线程池生命周期；并发集合不代替跨对象/数据库锁和模块并发协议。

findings.description: Naming/format/comment conventions need actual examples, Chinese code comments and explicit new-code scope, not unverified formatter enforcement.
findings.resolution: 命名/120宽度/短参数表为新增代码可读性规则，保留OperType等现有命名；中文代码注释和publicJavadoc规则保留，不冒称POM无声明格式器已验证。

findings.description: Functional permissions need trusted identity/assertion chain, public/ownership/internal exceptions and frontend/seed synchronization.
findings.resolution: JWT→可信断言→服务Authentication→方法权限明确；注册/协议/内部Token/ownership例外与seed/manifest/v-permission同步要求保留。

findings.description: DataPermission diagram/table wrongly restricts to sys_user and equates ALL to universal cross-tenant access.
findings.resolution: Auth三表映射与无通用TenantLine、领域固定拦截器次序分别说明；ALL/TENANT与上下文缺失不附条件不等于普遍跨租户授权。

findings.description: Role resolution, domain aggregate policies and new-table ownership mapping must match permission-aware actual source.
findings.resolution: 普通/permission-aware角色解析区分；领域owner/current-user/共享/子聚合映射由服务拥有，禁止给无列子表追加owner；在线ALL保留为特定例外。

findings.description: ThreadLocal set timing is wrong; cover filter/aspect cleanup and async boundaries.
findings.resolution: Auth在try内设置/finally清理；common-serviceFilter与方法Aspect生命周期分开；异步不自动传播，MQ需显式tenantId。

findings.description: XSS activation, Jackson 2/3 modules, query access methods, skip rules and fallback require actual source, not blanket sanitization.
findings.resolution: Servlet/Provider/classpath/Jackson2/3的真实激活条件、getParameter/Values与未覆盖Map、跳过条件、规则类型及非法regex行为如实同步。

findings.description: XSS Auth Redis invalidation and common-service cache/fallback boundaries must be distinct; headers are not input sanitization.
findings.resolution: Auth双Redis键TTL30分和主动失效、事务内删键竞态边界，common-service缓存/Auth/启用基线和权威关闭语义区分；响应头不冒称输入净化。

findings.description: MQ local transaction, tenant input, relay/admin query and schema ownership must retain current constraints and runtime limits.
findings.resolution: 正tenantId、实际本地事务、唯一DDL所有者、双注解、跨租户relay及tenant管理查询保留；送达/运行与依赖存在分开，教程归MQ/Wiki。

findings.description: OperLog example contradicts Auth prohibition; architecture and actual producer/consumer/archive scheduling need audit.
findings.resolution: OperLog改用真实Base字典update节选，Auth禁止规则保留；Outbox/直发/返回boolean限制与Base去重/重试、XXL归档handler/cron/180/1000按源修正。

findings.description: OperLog snapshots/truncation/SpEL/masking/failed operations and retention are scoped behavior, not comprehensive audit/compliance guarantees.
findings.resolution: 注解默认值与快照开关、tenant快照、顶层diff、规则脱敏、4000+标记及JSON风险、前置采集/responseStatus、归档同Bean事务限制均披露，不冒称全面审计或合规。

findings.description: Starter list, imports and override conditions are incomplete or overgeneralized; reactive module has no own custom imports.
findings.resolution: 10common/8customimports与reactive模块例外列明；MyBatis类型/Redis名称/RedisUtils返回型/OperLog无MissingBean条件分别解释，完整模块主源仍为架构。

findings.description: Configuration table has stale service set, weak password/token defaults and executor ports; distinguish formal Docker and YAML.
findings.resolution: 八服务宿主/容器、mysql私有omni_app、Nacos/JWKS映射与profile区分；Base9901与属性类9999、空通用Token与正式Compose私密Token不混同。

findings.description: Transactions readOnly/REQUIRES_NEW/Feign claims overstate guarantees; distinguish local transaction, proxy and remote effects.
findings.resolution: readOnly为提示而非授权，默认REQUIRED、本地/远程副作用、REQUIRES_NEW代理提交条件与自调用边界明确；Feign需独立协议适配。

findings.description: Troubleshooting and testing must retain local Docker, actual test scopes/conditional skips and exact source reuse without expensive repeats.
findings.resolution: 故障排查/源码调试职责和Docker句柄/副作用要求保留；JUnit/MockMvc/真实集成分开，条件skip不算pass，307精确树桥复用260/144不重跑未改构建。

findings.description: All four languages need whole semantic equivalence, actual source literals and role-preserving links; AI review suffices without human signoff.
findings.resolution: 18主节/44既有锚点保留，4全文1696行实际复读；52技术围栏严格同源，异常/配置/模块/链接一致；日文语境误替换和术语已纠正，保持AI非人工。
